problem: One virtual block can span cached files. Stop during the first pending read previously opened the next file; late I/O rejection also masked the prior Stop/failure.
fix: An optional caller assertion runs before allocation, immediately before each cached snapshot read, and after read resolution or rejection. The sender assertion checks its AbortSignal and failure/disposal state.

review.correctness: Six stopped resolve/reject combinations prevent later reads, frames and completion; exact original stop/failure reason survives. Browser healthy multi-file control verifies both files and full stream SHA. Previous 37 tests are byte-identical after removing the inserted six-case block (newline normalized).
review.readability: Small optional assertion at the read boundary; explicit catch preserves an earlier stop reason without hiding active I/O errors.
review.architecture: Caller owns cancellation state; generic virtual reader has no sender dependency, listener/controller lifecycle or new browser API. Existing three-argument callers keep behavior.
review.security: Prevents subsequent selected-file reads after stopping. No authorization, framing, digest, window, receipt or resume changes. Already-issued native I/O can settle.
review.performance: One closure per sender run, constant-time state checks per bounded read. No new payload buffers, timers, listeners or network calls. No performance acceptance inferred from check count.

fiveGiB.scope: 175-input predecessor before this patch; synthetic source, direct local SDP, production RTC/OPFS/save via injected handle. Diagnostic audit uses slice/arrayBuffer and is separate from production save. Repeating 256-byte fixture pattern is not general high-address source-offset proof.

matchedOneGiB.scope: Matched predecessor control; about15.92 MB/s versus5GiB15.41, within 3.3%. Earlier 44.56 MB/s discrepancy unexplained; no size-specific or causal performance diagnosis established.

artifactAvailability: 17 selected older C Temp paths are externally absent. Historical metadata hashes remain intact but do not establish retained raw data. Cause unknown; no old raw dataset recreated. New Oct17 profiles and copies are persistent outside Temp.
limitations: Native API channel is controlled; full browser tests are single-host headless RTC/OPFS with injected picker fixtures. No real two-laptop, native picker/default-handler GUI, clean OS or hosted CI acceptance.
The new patch has no current 5GiB rerun. Predecessor 5GiB/1GiB observations retain exact scope; 50–100GB/resource/throughput acceptance remains open.
42 physical cases remain not run. The caller assertion cannot cancel an already-issued kernel read or undo sent bytes.
